description:
Change a knowledge base. Only the fields you send are changed. Sending faqs replaces the whole list.

Requires scope `knowledge_bases:write`.

basic_info.description: Free text the agent should know: hours, address, pricing, policies.

description.description: What this knowledge base covers, for your own reference.

faqs.description: Question/answer pairs the agent can answer verbatim.

source_url.description: The website the content came from, e.g. the source_url of an import_knowledge_base draft.

name: update_knowledge_base
title: Update a knowledge base
